notes: Mirage shared row: spare width now goes into the COLUMNS, not only into the gaps - a card with room draws wider cells (a longer meter, a whole word) instead of wider holes, up to twice what a column ink needs.
Level controls say the whole word (VOLUME, MICROPHONE, BRIGHTNESS) and only take a short form when the card genuinely cannot hold it (CEO: "bright is just dumb .. no one says that").
New Glyph form for the levels, single and grouped: the glyph instead of the word over the level and its length. Any row column may now be named by its glyph instead of a word.
